*Transform your space with Artificial Turf Supply. Offering low-maintenance synthetic grass systems
that combine aesthetics and functionality. Made with high-quality components for a variety of
applications, discover the perfect artificial turf for your specific environment. From residential
lawns to commercial properties, pet areas, playgrounds, athletic fields, golf greens, gyms, and pool
decks, we have the solution for you.*

[Help Me Choose!][108]

Learn More

When it comes to artificial turf sports fields, FieldTurf is the most trusted brand in the industry.
Whether its football, soccer, baseball, rugby or any other sport, FieldTurf fields provide athletes
with the safety and performance they need to perform at their best, while giving field owners the
durability they want to maximize the value of their investment.

FieldTurf is a world leader in artificial turf with over 25,000 installations worldwide.

[ Buyer’s Guide][67]

**Learn more about the basics of turf and how to get started on your dream project [here][68].**

THE MOST TRUSTED BRAND IN THE INDUSTRY

When it comes to synthetic turf sports fields, FieldTurf is the most trusted brand in the industry.
FieldTurf, the synthetic turf division of Tarkett, invented and perfected long-pile, infilled
synthetic turf – we are the innovators who changed the industry and ultimately became the global
leader for outdoor sports solutions. Our aim was to create the very best playing surface possible,
combining the performance properties of natural grass with the benefits of a synthetic solution.

## THE OFFICIAL SYNTHETIC SURFACE PARTNER OF TGL

At TGL, presented by SoFi, the world’s best golfers play on turf engineered for true-to-life
performance. SYNLawn delivers the consistency, feel, and precision pros trust, bringing that same
level of play straight to your home or space.

[Learn More][165]
[SYNLawn | TGL An Official Partner]

## THE ONLY PLANT-BASED ARTIFICIAL GRASS

Welcome to SYNLawn, where turf looks and feels real without the hassle of real grass. For over two
decades, we’ve been redefining what artificial turf can do, delivering premium quality and
sustainable solutions without compromise. From backyards and dog parks to playgrounds, putting
greens, rooftops, and parks, we combine innovative technology, sustainable manufacturing, and
exceptional service to make every project stand out.

[GREEN TECHNOLOGIES][166]

## ARTIFICIAL TURF FOR EVERY APPLICATION

The SYNLawn branded product line of artificial grass and synthetic turf offers a wide variety of
surfacing solutions for commercial applications and residential lawn and landscaping.

that are available to you, and smart recommendations for the best fit for your unique project.
[Our Manufacturing Process][173]

## Coverage that goes the distance

Our commitment to quality doesn’t stop at installation. Our warranty protects against the most
common issues and is backed by decades of proven performance in every climate.

[Explore Warranty Coverage][174]

## greener with every project

With years of expertise in artificial grass, we're dedicated to providing eco-friendly, durable, and
aesthetically pleasing solutions. Our commitment to quality and customer satisfaction shapes every
blade of grass we produce, ensuring that we not only meet, but exceed, your landscaping
expectations.

## THE OFFICIAL SYNTHETIC SURFACE PARTNER OF TGL

At TGL, presented by SoFi, the world’s best golfers play on turf engineered for true-to-life
performance. SYNLawn delivers the consistency, feel, and precision pros trust, bringing that same
level of play straight to your home or space.

[Learn More][165]
[SYNLawn | TGL An Official Partner]

## THE ONLY PLANT-BASED ARTIFICIAL GRASS

Welcome to SYNLawn, where turf looks and feels real without the hassle of real grass. For over two
decades, we’ve been redefining what artificial turf can do, delivering premium quality and
sustainable solutions without compromise. From backyards and dog parks to playgrounds, putting
greens, rooftops, and parks, we combine innovative technology, sustainable manufacturing, and
exceptional service to make every project stand out.

[GREEN TECHNOLOGIES][166]

## ARTIFICIAL TURF FOR EVERY APPLICATION

The SYNLawn branded product line of artificial grass and synthetic turf offers a wide variety of
surfacing solutions for commercial applications and residential lawn and landscaping.

common issues and is backed by decades of proven performance in every climate.

# Lawn care service in lee’s summit

## [FERTILIZER][18] — [AERATION][19] — [GRUB CONTROL][20]


## Why Choose Turf Solutions?

### We have the experience!

Turf Solutions has over 25 years’ experience in lawn care in Lee’s Summit. Our technicians are state
licensed and tested by the Missouri Dept. of Agriculture and have ongoing lawn care training to keep
abreast of the latest turf products and safety issues to keep you and your family safe.

### Environmentally sensible Lawn Care

We are constantly seeking out the safest lawn care products on the market that have a low impact on
the environment while also retaining a safe place for your children and your pets to play. A healthy
lawn cools the environment, filters rainwater, prevents erosion and improves air quality. We test
our lawn care equipment daily to make sure we’re putting down just the right amount of product
during our lawn maintenance appointments.

### Guaranteed Results with Turf Solutions

We want you to be happy with our lawn care service. If you’ve signed up for our full lawn care
 program and you have weeds or your lawn is not looking like you think it should, we’ll come out
within 48 hrs and make it right, at no charge. That’s our lawn care  promise.

### Quick response time

We are not a huge lawn care franchise company where you feel like you’re getting lost in the crowd.
Turf Solutions is small enough you can expect to talk to a lawn care technician the same day you
call.

### Do away with the headaches of doing Lawn Care yourself

If you try and do your own shopping for fertilizer and pesticides (buying too much or too little),
handling and storage of materials, wrong timing of application, damage caused by poor application
(stripes or fertilizer burn, missed weeds) can be some of the outcomes when you are unfamiliar with
lawn care. Other headaches with doing your own lawn care may come from having to purchase expensive
lawn care equipment and lawn care books, and making trips to the garden center.

### Information at your fingertips

If you ever need help handling your regular lawn care needs, we’re just a phone call away. If need
be, a Turf Solutions technician will come out and meet you on your lawn to help you get the best
looking lawn you can have. Call or [contact us ][21]today for a beautiful lawn every summer.

## Why Choose Turf Solutions?

### We have the experience!

Turf Solutions has over 25 years’ experience in lawn care in Lee’s Summit. Our technicians are state
licensed and tested by the Missouri Dept. of Agriculture and have ongoing lawn care training to keep
abreast of the latest turf products and safety issues to keep you and your family safe.

### Environmentally sensible Lawn Care

We are constantly seeking out the safest lawn care products on the market that have a low impact on
the environment while also retaining a safe place for your children and your pets to play. A healthy
lawn cools the environment, filters rainwater, prevents erosion and improves air quality. We test
our lawn care equipment daily to make sure we’re putting down just the right amount of product
during our lawn maintenance appointments.

### Guaranteed Results with Turf Solutions

We want you to be happy with our lawn care service. If you’ve signed up for our full lawn care
 program and you have weeds or your lawn is not looking like you think it should, we’ll come out
within 48 hrs and make it right, at no charge. That’s our lawn care  promise.

### Quick response time

We are not a huge lawn care franchise company where you feel like you’re getting lost in the crowd.
Turf Solutions is small enough you can expect to talk to a lawn care technician the same day you
call.

### Do away with the headaches of doing Lawn Care yourself

If you try and do your own shopping for fertilizer and pesticides (buying too much or too little),
handling and storage of materials, wrong timing of application, damage caused by poor application
(stripes or fertilizer burn, missed weeds) can be some of the outcomes when you are unfamiliar with
lawn care. Other headaches with doing your own lawn care may come from having to purchase expensive
lawn care equipment and lawn care books, and making trips to the garden center.

### Information at your fingertips

If you ever need help handling your regular lawn care needs, we’re just a phone call away. If need
be, a Turf Solutions technician will come out and meet you on your lawn to help you get the best
looking lawn you can have. Call or [contact us ][21]today for a beautiful lawn every summer.

#### Non Infill

Non-infill artificial grass does not require infill materials such as sand or rubber pellets to
maintain its structure and functionality. Non-infill artificial grass consists of densely packed,
high-quality fibers that are intricately woven or tufted into a durable backing material. The dense
fiber structure helps maintain the shape and stability of the turf. One of the main advantages of
non-infill artificial grass is that it reduces maintenance requirements compared to traditional
infilled turfs. Additionally, non-infill turf can offer improved drainage capabilities, allowing
water to flow through the backing and into the underlying soil more efficiently. Non-infill
artificial grass is commonly used in various applications, including residential lawns, commercial
landscaping, sports fields, and play areas.

[Learn More][31] [All Products ][32]
[product-shape] [product-shape]
[https://agngrass.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Recyclable-1.png]

#### Recyclable

We offer recyclable and eco-friendly artificial grass with a coating made from PP DISP
(polypropylene dispersion) instead of SBR latex. This innovative technology allows for easy
separation and recycling of the turf at the end of its lifespan. Our sustainable solution provides
the same high-quality performance while reducing environmental impact. By choosing our recyclable
artificial grass, you can contribute to a circular economy and enjoy the benefits of low maintenance
and durability. Partner with us to create eco-friendly projects and make a positive environmental
impact.

[Learn More][33] [All Products ][34]
[product-shape] [product-shape]
[https://agngrass.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Accessoires-1.png]

accessories for our dealers. Our wholesale range includes products such as infill sand, artificial
grass hooks, safepads and artificial grass kits. These accessories improve the installation and
performance of artificial turf and provide stability, safety and convenience.

[Learn More][35] [All Products ][36]
[product-shape] [product-shape]

Our Padel Artificial Grass Kit line, complete with white lining for a professional touch.
Specifically designed for padel courts, this kit includes our high-quality artificial grass that
provides exceptional performance and durability. The kit also features UV-stability, ensuring
vibrant color retention even after extensive use. Elevate your padel court experience with our Padel
Artificial Grass Kit.

[Learn More][37] [All Products ][38]

Our Synthetic Hockey and Golf Grass is the ideal choice for dealers looking to improve field hockey

#### Non Infill

Non-infill artificial grass does not require infill materials such as sand or rubber pellets to
maintain its structure and functionality. Non-infill artificial grass consists of densely packed,
high-quality fibers that are intricately woven or tufted into a durable backing material. The dense
fiber structure helps maintain the shape and stability of the turf. One of the main advantages of
non-infill artificial grass is that it reduces maintenance requirements compared to traditional
infilled turfs. Additionally, non-infill turf can offer improved drainage capabilities, allowing
water to flow through the backing and into the underlying soil more efficiently. Non-infill
artificial grass is commonly used in various applications, including residential lawns, commercial
landscaping, sports fields, and play areas.

[Learn More][31] [All Products ][32]
[product-shape] [product-shape]
[https://agngrass.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/06/Recyclable-1.png]

#### Recyclable

We offer recyclable and eco-friendly artificial grass with a coating made from PP DISP
(polypropylene dispersion) instead of SBR latex. This innovative technology allows for easy
separation and recycling of the turf at the end of its lifespan. Our sustainable solution provides
the same high-quality performance while reducing environmental impact. By choosing our recyclable
artificial grass, you can contribute to a circular economy and enjoy the benefits of low maintenance
and durability. Partner with us to create eco-friendly projects and make a positive environmental
impact.

[Learn More][33] [All Products ][34]

performance of artificial turf and provide stability, safety and convenience.

Our Padel Artificial Grass Kit line, complete with white lining for a professional touch.

## Arizona Turf Depot

Arizona Turf Depot offers a wide selection of synthetic grass providing solutions to meet the
demands of residential or commercial applications creating a sustainable, non-watering and
functional surface. We can supply your individual requirements for all of your synthetic turf needs:

lawns
putting greens
playgrounds
pool surrounds
athletic fields
other landscaping projects

Our synthetic grass products are developed and produced by leading manufacturers and meet the
highest standards in **longevity, durability** and **stability.** Arizona Turf Depot grasses utilize
a soft polyethylene UV protected synthetic fiber to produce an attractive, realistic appearance and
low-maintenance lawn.

Installing synthetic grasses can realize water conservation saving of over 55,000 gallons of water
each year (based on an average 1,000 square foot lawn). They also pay for themselves as there are no
ongoing costs as with natural grass for maintenance (landscapers, thatching, aeration, gas, mower),
water, fertilizers, herbicides and pest controls.

As a small business, we rely not only on our quality products but even more importantly on our
customer service. Maintaining customer relationships with integrity, honesty and a straight forward
but friendly professional approach is pinnacle to Arizona Turf Depot. We service individual
homeowners and businesses as well as contractors.

### **FAQ’s**
1. **I’m in Phoenix and thinking about artificial turf, is it actually worth it here, or does it
   fade / melt in the heat? **Artificial turf is a strong fit for Phoenix as long as it’s rated for
   high UV exposure. Quality turf won’t melt, but cheap or low-grade products can fade or degrade
   faster in direct desert sun. Look for turf with UV-stabilized fibers and a manufacturer warranty
   of at least 10 years to avoid this issue.
2. **Can artificial turf handle a pool deck without getting slippery or too hot? **Yes, but the
   infill and drainage matter. Turf designed for pool areas should have strong drainage backing to
   handle splash-out and chlorine exposure, and heat-reducing infill options help keep it more
   comfortable barefoot near the pool.
3. **How do you clean and maintain artificial turf if you have dogs in Arizona? **Regular rinsing to
   flush the waste and odor. An antimicrobial and deodorizing spray are the standard maintenance
   routines. Properly drained turf in AZ typically needs less upkeep than real grass in the same
   climate.

### **FAQ’s**
1. **I’m in Phoenix and thinking about artificial turf, is it actually worth it here, or does it
   fade / melt in the heat? **Artificial turf is a strong fit for Phoenix as long as it’s rated for
   high UV exposure. Quality turf won’t melt, but cheap or low-grade products can fade or degrade
   faster in direct desert sun. Look for turf with UV-stabilized fibers and a manufacturer warranty
   of at least 10 years to avoid this issue.
2. **Can artificial turf handle a pool deck without getting slippery or too hot? **Yes, but the
   infill and drainage matter. Turf designed for pool areas should have strong drainage backing to
   handle splash-out and chlorine exposure, and heat-reducing infill options help keep it more
   comfortable barefoot near the pool.
3. **How do you clean and maintain artificial turf if you have dogs in Arizona? **Regular rinsing to
   flush the waste and odor. An antimicrobial and deodorizing spray are the standard maintenance
   routines. Properly drained turf in AZ typically needs less upkeep than real grass in the same
   climate.

### Enhance Your Yard's Beauty with Artificial Turf

Good artificial lawn starts with the right foundation.

• Existing soil is excavated to provide a grub free surface area.

• We then bring in three to four inches of compacted hard-pack providing a solid, smooth base.

• For our playground systems we add a layer of recycled padding to reduce injury from falls.  Our
playground systems meet ASTM and ADA standards.

• We then install Rocky Mountains unique line of artificial turf engineered to withstand the Rocky
Mountain region’s warm, dry climates. Rocky Mountain Turf’s products are manufactured with heavier
and stronger face weights and product composition that reduce surface temperatures by up to 30
degrees.

• The final step is to apply silica in-fill on top of the grass surface to provide ballast and
additional comfort.  We also offer in-fill options made specifically for pets and further
temperature reduction.

### Enhance Your Yard's Beauty with Artificial Turf

Good artificial lawn starts with the right foundation.

• Existing soil is excavated to provide a grub free surface area.

• We then bring in three to four inches of compacted hard-pack providing a solid, smooth base.

• For our playground systems we add a layer of recycled padding to reduce injury from falls.  Our
playground systems meet ASTM and ADA standards.

• We then install Rocky Mountains unique line of artificial turf engineered to withstand the Rocky
Mountain region’s warm, dry climates. Rocky Mountain Turf’s products are manufactured with heavier
and stronger face weights and product composition that reduce surface temperatures by up to 30
degrees.

• The final step is to apply silica in-fill on top of the grass surface to provide ballast and
additional comfort.  We also offer in-fill options made specifically for pets and further
temperature reduction.

Product Spotlight

Rekortan — World’s Most Certified Tracks

Used at the legendary 1984 LA Olympic Games, Rekortan is World Athletics’ most certified track brand
and holds the most Olympic Records of all time. Trusted by the Penn Relays since 1988 and chosen by
the legendary Michael Johnson for Grand Slam Track, Rekortan leads the way in athlete and
environmental performance. Rekortan Gel, with the most (50%) USDA certified components, is the
world’s greenest track system and uses trillions of biobased nano-structures to deliver superior
force reduction and energy return..

[Learn More][150]

Product Spotlight

Laykold- Surface of the US Open

Laykold is the Official Surface of the US Open, Miami Open,** **BNP Paribas Indian Wells and is
trusted and chosen by the most Masters 1000 tournaments. Laykold’s Grand Slam quality for tennis and
pickleball, serves up 10 x more pace precision than the industry standard and superior force
reduction for fast feet and happy knees. Made in the USA for 100 years, Laykold offers the most
court colors and market leading warranties.

[Learn more][151]

Product Spotlight

World Cup and Olympic Field Hockey Turf

Poligras by AstroTurf is the official hockey turf for the 2026 World Cup and the 2028 Olympics.
Trusted and chosen by athletes, schools and colleges worldwide LA is our 12^{th} Olympic Games. As
well as the much loved A12 turf, our portfolio includes the carbon zero Poligras Paris GT zero turf
which features advanced play wet / play dry performance.

### 🥋 Black-Belt Owned

Three black belts run this company. We train on the mats we sell.

### 🏭 Excellence, Factory Direct

From the factory floor to your training floor — no distributors, no resellers, no middle-markup.

### 🎖️ SDVOSB + Minority-Owned

Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business. Minority-Owned. Government and military discounts
available.

# ABOUT US (Mats With High Quality)

ATX Mats is your direct source for high-quality sport flooring at factory-direct prices. Founded in
2021, we set out with a clear mission: to deliver exceptional sport flooring products that exceed
expectations in performance, durability, and value. As a Service Disabled Veteran Owned and Minority
Owned Small Business, we take pride in offering accessible solutions without compromising quality.

Led by three Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belts, our team brings deep expertise and an authentic
passion for combat sports and athletic performance. That firsthand experience drives our commitment
to providing reliable flooring that stands up to the toughest training environments. Whether you’re
outfitting a martial arts gym, fitness studio, or personal training space, ATX Mats is here to
support your goals with products built to perform.

Redefining value. Reinventing durability. Designed for athletes, by athletes

Founded in 2021, ATX Mats was created to redefine the sports flooring market by delivering
factory-direct value and quality. Led by three Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belts, we bring unmatched
experience and passion to everything we do. Our mission is to provide durable, reliable, and
accessible sports flooring that meets the needs of athletes everywhere

## A Message From The Founders

Opening a new business or facility can be daunting. As small business owners ourselves, we
understand the challenges that come with building out a new training space. That’s exactly why we
founded ATX Mats—to offer all types of sports flooring in one place, from a trusted, factory-direct
source.

If your project allows for flexible lead times and cost control is a top priority, we may be the
right partner for you. If not, we still hope you find value in our commitment to delivering
competitive pricing and exceptional service.

Thank you in advance for the opportunity to earn your business. We appreciate your support—and we’ll
see you on the mats!

## Customer-Centric Approach

We’re here to help. Whether you’re a martial arts academy, gym owner, or purchasing for a larger
organization, we’re dedicated to meeting your sports flooring needs with personalized service and
attention to detail.

## Quality Assurance

All of our products are built for performance and durability, designed to withstand the demands of
rigorous training environments. We proudly stand behind the quality of everything we offer.

## Factory-Direct Prices

By eliminating the middleman, we’re able to offer top-quality products at unbeatable prices. That
means you get the best—without the markup.

## [Financing][20]
* [ Easy Financing For All Or Part of Any Project ][21]

## About Us

ATX Mats™ is a Service Disabled Veteran Owned & Minority Owned Small Business.

## Support

* [ Privacy Policy ][23]
* [ Contact Information ][24]
* [ Refund Policy ][25]

**ATX MATS™**

Email:** info@atxmats.com**

Physical address: **159 William Court, Austin, TX 78737**
* We do not sell or share your personal information

[ Facebook-f ][27] [ Instagram ][28] [ Youtube ][29]

Owned & Operated by Tim Fallon, Dande & Tussa — Black Belts. Designed in Austin, TX. Factory-Direct.

## How we work

ATX Mats is a direct line from your training space to our factory floor — not six retailers, six
lead times, and six phone trees.

You get **one project owner**, **one quote that covers everything** (design, manufacturing, ocean
freight, customs, and doorstep delivery), and **one place** to see status from kickoff through
reorder.

Every layout, every sample, every shipment is approved by the same small team of veterans and black
belts who train on these mats. Nothing leaves the factory without a human signature. No retailer
middlemen. No templated quotes. No pricing tricks.

[Start your design →][30] [Text us: 737-237-8693][31]

## Why ATX Mats

# ABOUT US (Mats With High Quality)

ATX Mats is your direct source for high-quality sport flooring at factory-direct prices. Founded in
2021, we set out with a clear mission: to deliver exceptional sport flooring products that exceed
expectations in performance, durability, and value. As a Service Disabled Veteran Owned and Minority
Owned Small Business, we take pride in offering accessible solutions without compromising quality.

Led by three Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belts, our team brings deep expertise and an authentic
passion for combat sports and athletic performance. That firsthand experience drives our commitment
to providing reliable flooring that stands up to the toughest training environments. Whether you’re
outfitting a martial arts gym, fitness studio, or personal training space, ATX Mats is here to
support your goals with products built to perform.

Redefining value. Reinventing durability. Designed for athletes, by athletes

Founded in 2021, ATX Mats was created to redefine the sports flooring market by delivering
factory-direct value and quality. Led by three Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu black belts, we bring unmatched
experience and passion to everything we do. Our mission is to provide durable, reliable, and
accessible sports flooring that meets the needs of athletes everywhere

## A Message From The Founders

Opening a new business or facility can be daunting. As small business owners ourselves, we
understand the challenges that come with building out a new training space. That’s exactly why we
founded ATX Mats—to offer all types of sports flooring in one place, from a trusted, factory-direct
source.

If your project allows for flexible lead times and cost control is a top priority, we may be the
right partner for you. If not, we still hope you find value in our commitment to delivering
competitive pricing and exceptional service.

Thank you in advance for the opportunity to earn your business. We appreciate your support—and we’ll
see you on the mats!

## Customer-Centric Approach

We’re here to help. Whether you’re a martial arts academy, gym owner, or purchasing for a larger
organization, we’re dedicated to meeting your sports flooring needs with personalized service and
attention to detail.

## Quality Assurance

All of our products are built for performance and durability, designed to withstand the demands of
rigorous training environments. We proudly stand behind the quality of everything we offer.

## Factory-Direct Prices

By eliminating the middleman, we’re able to offer top-quality products at unbeatable prices. That
means you get the best—without the markup.
